sql: SELECT e.name AS name, COUNT(m.id) AS n, AVG(m.value) AS mean_value FROM experiments AS e JOIN measurements AS m ON e.id = m.experiment_id GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY e.name
independent_check: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT AVG(value) FROM measurements WHERE experiment_id=1)=2.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
interpretation: The snapshot has two measurements per arm; this is an execution fact, not a causal claim.
